tagline: 尼康胶片单反相机，1988 年发布
description: 尼康于1988年推出的胶片单反相机。配备button on the left side of the lens mount。快门速度Electromagnetically controlled vertical-travel focal-plane metal shutter,。使用film automatically advances to first frame when shutter release button is depressed once。感光度6-6400 ASA, setting: DX code or by manual override, setting by the LCD display and the mode knob on the multi-settings dial on the left of the top plate。Autofocus and Manual with electronic rangefinder。

specs.镜头: button on the left side of the lens mount
specs.对焦: Autofocus and Manual with electronic rangefinder
specs.快门: Electromagnetically controlled vertical-travel focal-plane metal shutter,
specs.取景器: by pressing button on the back side of the top plate
specs.曝光测光: Matrix metering, centre-weighted metering (75/25) (spot metering on F-801S/N8008S)
specs.感光度: 6-6400 ASA, setting: DX code or by manual override, setting by the LCD display and the mode knob on the multi-settings dial on the left of the top plate
specs.胶片/画幅: film automatically advances to first frame when shutter release button is depressed once
specs.电池: 4 AA alkaline batteries, battery chamber opens by a screw on the right bottom side of the camera and the battery holder slides out
specs.光圈: f/3.3-f/22, setting: auto or manual by the ring and scale on the lens, w/ a lock button on it, locks at f/22
specs.英文简介: Nikon F-801 is a 35mm film SLR autofocus electronic camera, manufactured by Nikon Corporation, Japan and produced between 1988-1991.
